# 抓住从SEO到AEO的转变：月入1万美元的垂直工具如何诞生

作者：@bruteforcearete  
日期：2026-10-30（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/bruteforcearete/status/2116060690436030815)  
分类：工具推广

## 中文全文

过去二十年，在互联网上获取免费自然流量的套路一直相同：在博客文章里塞关键词、购买外链，然后希望 Google 把你排到第一页。但过去一年里，买家发现软件和服务的方式发生了根本性的分化。现在，数以百万计的人彻底跳过传统搜索引擎，直接问 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 或 Gemini，自己应该购买哪款产品。

我最近一边查看软件营收报告，一边整理我在 BuildersOfX 上维护的目录数据，并借助 AI 为这篇文章综合研究笔记。在这个过程中，一个新玩家格外突出：**AEO Engine**。这是一款聚焦“答案引擎优化”的工具，入门价格为 159 美元，月营收已经达到 10,000 美元。

企业已经订阅了传统 SEO 工具，为什么还愿意每月支付 159 美元以上，购买一个新品类的软件？因为传统 SEO 工具告诉你在十条蓝色链接中的排名，而创始人担心的是：当潜在客户问 AI 聊天机器人“最适合一家 10 人远程代理公司的薪资管理工具是什么？”时，自己的产品完全没有出现。

## “AI 可见性”浪潮中，从每月 100 美元到 1 万美元的创业蓝图

每当一个新的分发渠道出现，最先赚钱的往往是提供基础配套的监测工具：

- **本地商家 AI 引用审计工具（Web 应用）：**本地牙医、屋顶维修商和医疗美容机构，根本不知道本地居民请求推荐时，ChatGPT 或 Apple Intelligence 会怎么说。可以做一个简单的诊断型 Web 应用，每月收费 29 美元：针对某个邮政编码区域的本地服务问题，查询四个主流大语言模型，再给企业主列出一份需要补齐的目录收录和引用清单，例如 Yelp、BBB、Reddit 提及、结构化 Schema 数据，以改善其可见性。

- **llms.txt 与 Markdown 文档同步插件：**开发一个 WordPress、Webflow 或 Shopify 扩展，自动维护一份简洁、经过 token 优化的 /llms.txt 目录，汇总企业的价格和文档，让 AI 爬虫能够准确索引产品。

看看 BuildersOfX 上的真实数字，结论很清楚：要打造一项能够改变生活的软件资产，并不需要庞大团队或风险投资。找到一个会让人烦恼二十分钟的问题，把它变成一键操作的按钮，再把这个按钮放在人们已经在工作的地方。

## 外文原文

For twenty years, the playbook for getting free organic traffic on the internet was identical: stuff keywords into blog posts, buy backlinks, and hope Google puts you on page one. But over the last year, the way buyers discover software and services has fundamentally fractured. Millions of people now skip traditional search engines entirely and ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Gemini what product they should buy.

As I was reviewing recent software revenue reports alongside the directory data I curate on BuildersOfX, using AI to help synthesize my research notes for this essay, a clear newcomer stood out: **AEO Engine**, a focused tool generating $10,000 a month in revenue by tackling "Answer Engine Optimization" at a $159 entry point.

Why are companies willing to pay $159+ a month for a new category of software when they already have legacy SEO subscriptions? Because traditional SEO tools tell you where you rank on ten blue links, while founders fear being invisible when a prospect asks an AI chatbot, "What is the best payroll tool for a 10-person remote agency?"

$100 to $10K/Month Blueprints in the "AI Visibility" Wave

Whenever a new distribution channel emerges, the "picks and shovels" monitoring tools print money first:

- **The Local Business AI Citation Auditor (Web App):** Local dentists, roofers, and med-spas have no idea what ChatGPT or Apple Intelligence says when a local resident asks for a recommendation. Build a simple $29/month diagnostic web app that queries the top 4 LLMs for local service prompts in a specific zip code and gives the business owner a checklist of missing directory citations (Yelp, BBB, Reddit mentions, structured schema) to fix their visibility.

- **An llms.txt & Markdown Documentation Sync Plugin:** Build a WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify extension that automatically maintains a clean, token-optimized /llms.txt directory of a company's pricing and docs, so AI crawlers index their product accurately.

When you look at the real numbers on BuildersOfX, the takeaway is clear: you don't need a massive team or venture capital to build a life-changing software asset. Find a twenty-minute frustration, turn it into a one-click button, and put it right where people are already working.
